title: 三星营业利润创纪录：芯片利润却略低预期，净利润差一截该怪谁？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Finally, have these Assam's numbers crossing the Bloomberg. It's a miss when it comes to the net.
segments.zh: 最后，来看三星的业绩数据。净利润不及预期。

segments.en: Third quarter net coming in at 75.2 trillion won.
segments.zh: 第三季度净利润为75.2万亿韩元。

segments.en: The estimate was for 89 trillion won, just over 89 trillion won.
segments.zh: 市场预期为89万亿韩元，略高于89万亿韩元。

segments.en: Third quarter sales coming in at 195.25 trillion won.
segments.zh: 第三季度销售额为195.25万亿韩元。

segments.en: The operating profit at 107.44 trillion won there.
The chip operating profit, if you split that out coming through a little bit shy of expectations of 108 trillion won.
segments.zh: 芯片营业利润单独来看略低于预期的108万亿韩元。

segments.en: It's come through 106.5 trillion won there. So a little bit softer.
segments.zh: 实际为106.5万亿韩元，所以略偏软。

segments.en: But certainly it is that net number that we're looking at 75.21 trillion won against expectations of 89.06 trillion won.
segments.zh: 但净利润数据确实值得关注：75.21万亿韩元，预期为89.06万亿韩元。

segments.en: So we did also see that disappointment when it comes to net really play through when it comes to SK Heinix as well.
segments.zh: 我们也看到SK海力士同样出现这种失望情绪。

segments.en: And that had been what invested have been reacting at.
segments.zh: 这正是市场参与者一直在反应的情况。

segments.en: But these numbers have come through a little bit later than expected.
segments.zh: 但这些数据比预期稍晚一些公布。

segments.en: We'll be watching very closely when it comes to Capac's numbers in particular for cash flow, given that AI is sort of still in that sort of cyclical point.
segments.zh: 我们将密切关注Capac的现金流数据，因为AI仍处于周期阶段。

segments.en: So the good results should promote more Capac's investment.
segments.zh: 因此良好的业绩应会推动更多Capac的配置。

segments.en: So we'll be looking at that as well as any comments in the press conference to come later on today on just how long they see this cycle going on for
segments.zh: 所以我们将关注这一点，以及今天晚些时候新闻发布会上的任何评论，关于他们预计这个周期会持续多久

segments.en: and the shortage, supply shortage, pushing through for potentially through 2030.
segments.zh: 以及供应短缺可能持续到2030年。
